title: Crypto misuse: kcapi provider bypasses FIPS gate on all crypto ops
description: src/providers/kcapi/kcapi_aead.c:452 and kcapi_skcipher.c:365/383/407 — kcapi_gcm_aes_ops, kcapi_cbc_aes_ops, kcapi_ctr_aes_ops, kcapi_xts_aes_ops all set .fips_gate = NULL. fd.c:385 checks 'if (state->ops && state->ops->fips_gate)' and silently skips the gate when fips_gate is NULL. Trigger: wolfCrypt FIPS module enters error/degraded state; user requests gcm(aes) or cbc(aes) from the kcapi provider. Consequence: FIPS degradation is not enforced — crypto operations continue through the kcapi path without checking whether the wolfCrypt FIPS module is operational. This is a FIPS 140-3 operational requirement violation: every cryptographic operation must be gated behind the FIPS health check.
